categories.name: quantified exact count
categories.remediation_contract: Recognize explicit counts even when universal or approximate quantifiers require qualification.

categories.name: ordinal ranking with time
categories.remediation_contract: Represent rank, population, measure and reference period as typed operands.

categories.name: absence or zero-use status
categories.remediation_contract: Recognize absence claims when retained evidence can bind a nonzero counterexample or status.

categories.name: relative measurement
categories.remediation_contract: Recognize ordinary comparative language grounded by explicit measurements and reference populations.

categories.name: paired-value comparison
categories.remediation_contract: Extract both values, units, subjects and the comparison relation.

categories.name: multiplicative comparison
categories.remediation_contract: Extract ratio or multiplicative language and bind both comparison values.

categories.name: dated projection
categories.remediation_contract: Preserve start value/date, end value/date and projection modality.

categories.name: dated scalar
categories.remediation_contract: Bind the scalar value and its material reference date in one linked construction.

categories.name: compound conditions
categories.remediation_contract: Create linked assertions for every threshold, duration, scope and consequence.

categories.name: material qualifier loss
categories.remediation_contract: Reject claim spans or evidence bindings that omit a material qualifier or scope.

categories.name: decisive evidence omission
categories.remediation_contract: Require bindings for support, contradiction or qualification needed by deterministic verification.

categories.name: scalar normalization mismatch
categories.remediation_contract: Normalize compatible magnitude and unit forms before explicit-binding validation.

categories.name: invalid scale
categories.remediation_contract: Fail closed on nonpositive scales and preserve the terminal receipt and safe error.

categories.name: open-world or causal exclusion
categories.remediation_contract: Continue excluding unsupported superlative, causal and universal generalization claims.

categories.name: failed response usage gap
categories.remediation_contract: Persist provider usage or explicit unknown usage plus a conservative cost upper bound for every attempted response.
